name: Sample Mission Talk Line
how_to_start: Call or use the web chat. You don't need an appointment.
summary: A friendly person to talk with when you've had a hard day and don't want to wait.
script: Hi, I'm a college student and I'm having a hard time today. Can I talk with someone for a bit?

name: Sample Sunset Drop-In Counseling
how_to_start: Walk in during drop-in hours, or call to ask when the next opening is.
summary: A few counseling visits for when stress, school or family has been a lot lately.
script: Hi, I'm a college student. I'd like to come in for drop-in counseling. When are your drop-in hours this week?

name: Sample Bay Student Counseling Online
cost_note: Sliding scale: $15 to $60 a visit, based on what you earn. Call to confirm.
how_to_start: Call and ask for a first video visit.
summary: Short-term video counseling for students who want to talk things through in a few sessions.
script: Hi, I'm a college student looking for short-term counseling by video. Do you have openings soon? What would it cost on your sliding scale?

name: Sample Richmond Community Therapy
cost_note: Sliding scale: $10 to $50 a visit. Free with Medi-Cal. Call to confirm.
how_to_start: Call and ask for an intake appointment.
summary: Weekly therapy for when you've felt down or worried for weeks and want steady support.
script: Hi, I'm a college student looking for ongoing therapy. Are you taking new clients, or is there a waitlist? I have Medi-Cal (or no insurance). What would my cost be?

name: Sample Castro Affirming Therapy Collective
cost_note: Sliding scale: $30 to $90 a visit. Some insurance plans accepted. Call to confirm.
how_to_start: Call and ask for a free 15-minute phone chat to see if it's a good fit.
summary: Ongoing therapy with an LGBTQ+ affirming team, in person or by video.
script: Hi, I'm a college student looking for ongoing therapy. Are you taking new clients? I'd like to ask about your sliding scale.

name: Sample Hilltop Therapy Group
cost_note: Uses insurance. Your cost depends on your plan, often a set copay. Call to confirm.
how_to_start: Call with your insurance card ready and ask for an intake appointment.
summary: Weekly in-person therapy close to campus, for when things have felt heavy for a while.
script: Hi, I'm a college student looking for ongoing therapy. Are you taking new clients? I have [name of your plan]. Do you take it, and what would my copay be?

name: Sample Telehealth Therapy Network
cost_note: Uses insurance. Your cost depends on your plan. Call to confirm.
how_to_start: Call and ask to be matched with a therapist licensed in the state where you'll be.
summary: Video therapy that can continue when you go home for breaks, if your state is covered.
script: Hi, I'm a college student looking for ongoing video therapy. I'll be in [state] over break. Do you have a therapist who can see me there? I have [name of your plan].

name: Sample Medication Clinic Online
cost_note: Uses insurance. Your cost depends on your plan. Call to confirm.
how_to_start: Call and ask for a medication evaluation appointment.
summary: Video visits with a prescriber to talk about whether medicine might help.
script: Hi, I'm a college student and I'd like a medication evaluation. Are you taking new patients, or is there a waitlist? I have [name of your plan].

name: Sample Excelsior Family Health Center
cost_note: Sliding scale: $0 to $40 a visit. Free with Medi-Cal. Call to confirm.
how_to_start: Call and ask for a new-patient visit for a medication evaluation.
summary: A community health center where you can meet with a prescriber about medicine.
script: Hi, I'm a college student and I'd like a medication evaluation. Are you taking new patients? I have Medi-Cal (or no insurance). What would it cost?

name: Sample Tenderloin Free Clinic
how_to_start: Call to get on the list for a medication visit.
summary: A free clinic with evening hours for medication visits.
script: Hi, I'm a college student and I'd like a medication evaluation. How long is the waitlist right now? Is it still free?

name: Sample Mission Bilingual Counseling
cost_note: Sliding scale: $5 to $40 a visit. Call to confirm.
how_to_start: Call and ask for a first counseling visit this week.
summary: Short-term counseling in English or Spanish, often with a visit the same week.
script: Hi, I'm a college student and I'd like to talk to a counselor soon. Do you have anything this week? I can talk in English or Spanish.

name: Sample Peer Support Chat
how_to_start: Open the web chat or call. A trained peer answers.
summary: Chat with a trained peer who gets what student life is like.
script: Hi, I'm a student and I could use someone to talk to right now.

name: Sample Noe Valley Counseling
cost_note: Sliding scale: $25 to $75 a visit. Call to confirm.
how_to_start: Call and ask for an intake appointment.
summary: Ongoing therapy with a sliding scale.
script: Hi, I'm a college student looking for ongoing therapy. Are you taking new clients?

name: Sample Downtown Psychiatry Practice
how_to_start: Call and ask for a medication evaluation.
script: Hi, I'm a college student and I'd like a medication evaluation. Are you taking new patients?

name: Sample Online Sliding-Scale Therapy
cost_note: Sliding scale: $20 to $60 a visit. Call to confirm.
how_to_start: Call and ask to join the waitlist.
summary: Video therapy with a sliding scale.
script: Hi, I'm a college student looking for video therapy. How long is your waitlist?

name: Sample Bayview Wellness Line
summary: A support line for when you need to talk.
script: Hi, I'm a student and I'd like to talk to someone.
